mechanism: Both agents are CNS depressants that additively depress central nervous system function; carisoprodol is metabolized to meprobamate (also CNS depressant) and both drugs have anticholinergic properties.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, impaired coordination, and respiratory depression; educate patients to avoid alcohol and other CNS depressants.
